convert_box_mode: convert bounding boxes from XYWH_ABS format to XYXY_ABS format using BoxMode.convert
create_boxes_tensor: create a Boxes object from a torch tensor with Nx4 coordinates in XYXY format
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise intersection over union between two Boxes objects using pairwise_iou
clip_boxes_to_image: clip bounding boxes in place to fit within an image height and width using Boxes.clip
compute_matched_iou: compute diagonal IoU between two matched box lists of equal length using matched_boxlist_iou
